subject: Predeclared promotion gates for the context-window and multimodal-upscale arms
written_before: either arm was pushed to Kaggle. No result existed when this file was written.
why_this_file_exists: The reasoning-effort arm on 2026-08-20 PASSED its written gate and still had to be rejected, because the gate's level floor was calibrated against the 19-level historical control instead of the 23-level config we actually ship. A floor below what you deploy cannot catch a regression. Both gates below are calibrated against combined-v2, the shipped config.
shared_preconditions: All 25 games must run. Any game that fails to start voids the arm.
Zero vLLM server relaunch-to-stock events. The serving overlay falls back on launch failure; if it fires, the arm did not test what it claims to test.
Peak GPU KV cache usage strictly below 0.90. Above that vLLM preempts and the comparison is confounded by scheduling, not by the change.
Context-overflow retries must not exceed 2 percent of analyzer requests. This is the specific way a larger history budget can backfire: a prompt that no longer leaves room for the thinking trace.

q38-context-window-v1.mechanism_claim: The agent retains a median of 6 of its own prior decisions at the shipped budget while a median game needs about 102 actions to reach level 2. Raising the budget to 48128 raises retained turns to a median of 9 and cuts the history-drop rate from 28.1 to 19.8 percent, measured by replaying the shipped trim policy over the 25 combined-v2 transcripts.
PROMOTE_requires_all_of: total_levels >= 23, i.e. at least ties the shipped config
median retained assistant turns per request strictly greater than the control's
generation throughput within 20 percent of the control's 533.3 tok/s
REJECT_if_any_of: context-overflow retries above 2 percent of analyzer requests
q38-context-window-v1.INCONCLUSIVE_band: total_levels 21 or 22: inside the +/-6-level noise of a byte-identical rerun. Do not ship on it; rerun or drop.

q38-ctxwin-upscale16-v1.independent_variable: MULTIMODAL_UPSCALE 8 -> 16, on top of the context-window arm
q38-ctxwin-upscale16-v1.mechanism_claim: patch_size 16 and spatial_merge_size 2 mean one vision token covers 32x32 pixels. At upscale 8 a 64x64 frame renders to 512x512, so one vision token spans a 4x4 block of 16 ARC cells and the image channel cannot resolve a single cell. Upscale 16 makes it 2x2 cells at 1024 vision tokens per frame. The processor will not resize it away: max pixels 16777216, min 65536, and 1024x1024 is 1048576.
q38-ctxwin-upscale16-v1.honest_status: MECHANISM BET. There is no offline measurement behind this arm, unlike the context-window arm. Upstream deliberately set 8 where the code default is 16, which is weak evidence against it.
REJECT_if_any_of: generation throughput below 400 tok/s (the image tokens have made each request too expensive)

q38-image-token-estimate-v1.independent_variable: history-trimmer image accounting only. setup_commands.json is byte-identical to combined-v2; the only changed file in the whole bundle is tool_agent.py (+58/-3 lines).
q38-image-token-estimate-v1.mechanism_claim: _estimate_tokens is len(json.dumps(payload))/3 over the whole request, and the grid PNG is embedded as a base64 data URL, so the trimmer prices an image by its base64 length. Measured through the shipped renderer on a 64x64 frame: 1,585 estimated tokens against a true 256, a 6.2x over-charge. Images persist one per retained user message, so at the shipped 31,744 budget roughly 30 percent of the history budget is phantom. Correcting it is worth about +29 percent retained turns on its own and composes with the window arm to about +96 percent.
q38-image-token-estimate-v1.why_it_is_lower_risk_than_the_other_two: It changes no real token, no prompt, no sampling and no serving flag. It only makes the trimmer's arithmetic true. Text is still over-estimated at len/3 against roughly 3.5 real characters per token, so the corrected estimate stays conservative and cannot push a request past max-model-len.
PROMOTE_requires_all_of: median retained assistant turns per request strictly greater than the control's
REJECT_if_any_of: context-overflow retries above 2 percent of analyzer requests

what_neither_gate_can_establish: That either arm raises the hidden-set mean. A byte-identical rerun of one bundle differed by 6 levels and 2.04 mean score, and byte-identical submissions of the same bundle scored 1.68 and 1.05. A single 25-game commit cannot resolve anything smaller than that. These gates exist to catch REGRESSIONS and to confirm the MECHANISM moved, which is the standard that promoted context hysteresis.

retained_turn_model.method: marginal text tokens per retained turn = 4,230, fitted from three replay points of the shipped trim policy over the 25 combined-v2 transcripts; image charge measured through the shipped renderer on one synthetic 64x64 frame. An ordering, not a forecast.
retained_turn_model.consequence_for_arm_B: Arm B is roughly history-NEUTRAL against the shipped config (1.09x), not a regression, because the raised window very nearly pays for upscale 16's larger phantom charge. That was not the intent when arm B was built and it is recorded here as a lucky accident: it makes arm B a fairer test of the vision channel than it was designed to be. Kaggle exposes no kernel-cancel endpoint, so arm B could not be replaced once this was understood.
